WITH account_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    COUNT(*) as order_count,
    CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order`) as share
  FROM `order`
  GROUP BY account_id
),
with_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    order_count,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER () as avg_share
  FROM account_shares
)
SELECT 
  SUM(order_count) as total_orders,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(share - avg_share) as avg_distance_above_avg
FROM with_avg
WHERE share > avg_share
